interaction_motion.evidence: hover.png and focus.png were not captured (skip-link off-canvas). CSS has :focus-visible 3px, hover/active on named controls, 150ms transitions inside prefers-reduced-motion:no-preference, 650ms mosaic entrance, DNA sway gated. Audit: has_motion true, has_reduced_motion_rule true, overshoot_easing false, focus_invisible_count 0. Generic body anchors have no hover.
strengths: 3px :focus-visible ring on 25 controls; audit reports 0 invisible focus.
Motion is opt-in: 150ms control feedback and one 650ms mosaic entrance.
prefers-reduced-motion gating leaves panes at their settled state.

issues.problem: Named .btn/.link/.nav/.foot/.phones controls have hover; generic anchors do not.
issues.fix: Add a:hover{color:var(--deep)} a:active{color:var(--void)} and include a in the transition list.

issues.problem: Hover can still paint a busy submit deep navy. Button label stays Send quote request.
issues.fix: Add .btn[disabled]:hover,.btn[disabled]:active with pointer-events none. Set submit text to Sending while aria-busy.

issues.problem: Column delays are overridden by last-child delay, so all three panes enter at 150ms.
issues.fix: Delete the last-child delay. Keep nth-child(2) at .12s and nth-child(3) at .24s.

issues.problem: JS sets aria-invalid but CSS has no invalid border.
Pressed equals hover on the navy-band primary.
